interface.signature: def search(S: str, pat: str) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.description: S and pat are non-empty strings with 1 ≤ |S| ≤ 10^5 and 1 ≤ |pat| ≤ |S|.
The length of pat is less than or equal to the length of S.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= start <= len(S) - len(pat) + 1 for start in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each start index in the returned list is a valid 1-based starting position for pat in S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[start-1:start+len(pat)-1] == pat for start in return_value)
postconditions.description: For every start index in the returned list, the substring of S starting at start-1 (0-based) matches pat exactly.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(S) - len(pat) + 2) if S[i-1:i+len(pat)-1] == pat)
postconditions.description: The returned list contains exactly all valid 1-based starting indices of pat in S, with no duplicates or omissions.
